whatItIs.text: The bulb onion, most widely cultivated member of the Allium family and the starting point of more recipes than any other vegetable — it is known only from cultivation, its wild ancestor lost to time.

historyNote.text: The shallot, long treated as its own species, was reclassified in 2011 as a botanical variety of the onion — a reminder that the Allium family is one continuum of domesticated bulbs.

howToChoose.text: Choose firm, dry bulbs with papery skins and no soft spots, green shoots, or sprouting; heavier onions mean juicier layers.

storage.text: Keep whole onions cool, dark, and airy — not in the fridge or next to potatoes.

foodSafetyRef.note: Practice storage guidance only; no rulebook content is claimed. The app's food-safety rules live in data/food-safety/rules.json.

useItUp.text: Cut onions become caramelised onions, quick pickles, or the flavour base of whatever soup is next.

substitutions.note: sweeter, gentler, more elegant in vinaigrettes
for rubs and dressings; no texture
